## \#Iconic\_Autumn

# UNFORGETTABLE MOMENTS AT OESCHINENSEE

##### **Arrive, recharge your batteries, experience, breathe, calm down, enjoy - feel nature.**

Welcome to the unspoiled beauty of the UNESCO World Heritage Site “ Oeschinensee ”—a unique natural gem. The Kandersteg “ Cable car ” (Oeschinensee ) is the gateway to one of Switzerland’s most iconic natural paradises and a flagship tourist destination in the region. Immerse yourself in the idyllic autumn landscape, surrounded by majestic mountains.

[ARRIVAL BY TRAIN (PUBLIC TRANSPORT)](https://www.oeschinensee.ch/en/#)

![Oeschinensee](https://cdn.shortpixel.ai/spai/q_glossy+w_300+h_209+to_auto+ret_img/www.oeschinensee.ch/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/DJI_20250812142842_0186_D_WEB%C2%A9christianpfammatter-2048x1425.jpg)

Arrival by train

For a stress-free journey, we recommend using public transport. Whether through the Kandertal valley or from Valais through the Lötschberg tunnel, you can easily reach Kandersteg by train.

From the train station, a footpath (approx. 15 min.) leads directly to the valley station ofOeschinensee Cable car . From here, you can either take the Cable car walk up to the shore of Lake Oeschinen.

With a SBB Half-Fare Card/GA travelcard or a Swiss Travel Pass, you can ride the Cable car half price. Not valid for ski day tickets. Buy your ticket directly in our [ticket shop](https://oeschinensee.skiperformance.com/en/).

[ARRIVAL BY CAR](https://www.oeschinensee.ch/en/#)

![Oeschinensee](https://cdn.shortpixel.ai/spai/q_glossy+w_300+h_215+to_auto+ret_img/www.oeschinensee.ch/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/F1006096_DRUCK%C2%A9christianpfammatter-2048x1466.jpg)

Arrival by car

If you’re traveling by car, the route takes you through the village of Kandersteg directly to Cable car valley station. We recommend arriving early, especially during peak season and on weekends, when large crowds are expected.

If you are visiting Oeschinensee car, it is best to follow the signs on the main road toward Kandersteg. Immediately after the small bridge, across from Käthy Sport + Mode, turn off and follow the road along the stream to the valley station.

RV and vehicles over 5 meters in length and 2 meters in height cannot park at the valley station. Please park at the Schützenhaus parking lot or in the village. Limited number of spaces available.

Parking availability in Kandersteg is limited on weekends and during the summer season. We recommend traveling by public transportation. Paid parking spaces are available at the valley station. Additional paid parking spaces are located in the village. Please follow the parking guidance system and the instructions of the traffic service on site.

Eight 11kW electric charging stations are available at the "P2" parking lot near the valley station. Entry is possible even when the parking lot is full—simply press the button on the entry column. Charging cables are available at the ticket office.

Please park only in the designated and signposted parking spaces or bays. Access roads must not be blocked.

[BUY TICKET ONLINE](https://oeschinensee.skiperformance.com/en/)

## Gold, Silver, and Bronze Cards – Order Online Now

With your annual pass, you can travel to the Oeschinensee s for hiking in the summer and
for skiing in the winter. For the " ascent ," you do not need
a time slot reservation if you have a valid annual pass.

### Gold card

For residents of the municipality of Kandersteg.

Adults **CHF 100.–**

Children ages 6 to 15 **CHF 50.–**

[Order a Gold Card](https://form.jotform.com/262947047782368)

### Silver card

For residents of Kandergrund, Frutigen, Reichenbach
(including Kiental) or Adelboden.

Adults **CHF 150.–**

Children ages 6 to 15 **CHF 75.–**

[Order a Silver Card](https://form.jotform.com/262946607101354)

### Bronze card

For people with a second home—an apartment or a
vacation home—in Kandersteg.

Adults **CHF 250.–**

Children ages 6 to 15 **CHF 125.–**

[Order a Bronze Card](https://form.jotform.com/262891703926062)

Annual passes are personal, non-transferable, and valid for twelve months starting on the selected
start date. Published operating hours apply.
Children under 6 ride for free.

You can add a Sunnbüel transfer pass
for adults or children to your Silver or Bronze pass. The combined annual parking pass
for the Oeschinensee , and Sunnbüel valley stations is also available separately.
You can find both options on the respective form under “Additional Options.”

If you already have an annual pass, select
the "Renewal" option under "Order Type" on the form.

Warning signs include fresh impact marks, rock deposits, and areas where rock has broken away. The more exposed the trail is, the higher the risk—in such areas, it is important to proceed quickly. What outdoor guidelines apply to behavior on pastures?
